# SheetJS Community Edition

Version: 0.20.3

File: `xlsx.mini.min.js`

Source: `https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js`

SHA-256: `0cb353f830d7288385492c83d277b058ddeac664ca51cf1393aa1fd3e2b70939`

License: Apache License 2.0. The unmodified license text is stored in `SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt`.

Purpose: Local browser parsing of `.xlsx` roster files. The mini build omits legacy XLS and extra code-page support. The file is vendored so roster data does not require a runtime network request.

Review date: 2026-08-25

Official documentation reviewed:

- `https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/`
- `https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/solutions/input/`
- `https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/api/parse-options/`
- `https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/miscellany/security/`
- `https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/miscellany/license/`

No local modifications were made to the vendored script or license.
